notes.title: V1.2 Release - Major Update
notes.content:
- Added OS support for Windows 32-bit and Mac 64-bit systems.
 - Performance Improvements.
 - New start screen graphics and animations
 - Rebalanced difficulty progression (slightly easier).

notes.title: V1.1 Update - New Features
notes.content:
Hi All,

After some feedback, I have added end of round statistics including: 
- Balloons Popped
- Total Clicks
- Accuracy
- Bonus Points Awarded

Also included in the update is the addition of touchscreen support for windows devices and a Top 5 highscore list.

Now back to popping balloons..
